Owning a Bird Feeder, Shouldn’t Mean Feeding the Squirrels

A bird house that sticks to your glass, welcomes birds in, and keeps rodents out.

Buy for $44.99 See how it works

One house. Two eucalyptus bags. Four suction cups included.

Made to bring birds in and keep trouble out.

Three simple ideas make the Feather Frame different from a bird house on a post.

Suction cup mount

Press it onto any clean window. No drilling, no nails, no ladders. Watch birds up close from inside.

Eucalyptus bags

A bag clips onto each side of the house. The scent attracts birds and helps keep rodents away.

Rodent resistant

Raised off the ground and on glass, it is hard for rodents to reach, so birds get a safe place to rest.

Up on your window in a minute.

No tools needed.

  1. Clean the glass

    Wipe the spot where you want the house so the suction cups grip well.

  2. Press and stick

    Push the four suction cups firmly against the window.

  3. Add the eucalyptus

    Clip a bag to each side, then wait for your first visitor.

About us

Hello! We are Feather Frame, a student run business formed through the LEAD Academy at Streamwood High School. We are currently in the ACCELerator program, following a very successful year within the incubator program!

Our goal is to create an accessible bird feeder for all, that will attract birds and keep all pesky rodents away from the bird seed within the feeder.
